$comment: Generated by 'spectool render' from vectors/payload/guideline.yaml - do not edit.
description: Golden payload vectors taken from Appendix B (MG B1.1.1 … B1.1.12, B1.2.1): topic and message of the Message Bus, including the Birth, Close and Will messages (MG 6.3.3 … 6.3.5, C-025); and the predefined MetaData of the Alliance resources (MG B2.1 … B2.8) as bare DataSetMetaDataType objects. The reference checks cover the envelope of MG 8 (areas MSG and ACT) and, since C-027, the DataSet content of MAM, Health, Profile, PublicationList, ReferenceDesignation and the helper DataSets Pagination, PaginationRequest, Locale and Query (areas RES-MAM … QRY), since C-028 also of Data (Oi4Pv), Metadata (Get), Event and SubscriptionList, since C-029 also of Config. A vector that differs from its example keeps the verbatim example in original and lists every change in edits.

vectors.title: B1.1.2: Get Health of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: A request addresses the application in the topic (MG 7.3); the PublisherId and the MessageId are those of the requesting IT connector. The Source of the topic is the application itself. A Get without helper DataSets has an empty Messages array and an empty ReplyTo.

vectors.title: B1.1.2: Get Health of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Same payload as V-PAY-001 on the topic without Source. A request has an empty ReplyTo (the former "self-initialized" note of the Get examples was removed in C-024, SF-049 (h)).

vectors.title: B1.1.2: Pub Health of an explicit asset, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: ReplyTo is the MessageId of V-PAY-001. WriterGroupName is "" because Health has no Filter; DataSetWriterName is the decoded Source. The DataSet content (MG 8.3.2) is checked with the Health schema in C-027/C-028.

vectors.title: B1.1.2: Pub Health of all assets, self-initialized
vectors.notes: Topic without Source: one DataSetMessage per asset; here only the application itself. Self-initialized publication, so ReplyTo is empty.

vectors.title: B1.1.11: Get MAM of all assets with PaginationRequest
vectors.notes: The helper DataSet PaginationRequest uses DataSetWriterId 1, WriterGroupName "PaginationRequest" and the Identification Link of the sender as DataSetWriterName. The NetworkMessage keeps the DataSetClassId of MAM (REQ- MSG-011).

vectors.title: B1.1.11: Pub MAM of all assets with Pagination
vectors.notes: Two MAM DataSetMessages (application and one device, WriterGroupName "" as MAM has no Filter) and the helper DataSet Pagination (DataSetWriterId 2). The MAM content (MG 8.3.1) is checked with the MAM schema in C-027/C-028.

vectors.title: B1.1.12: Get MAM of all assets with Locale
vectors.notes: The helper DataSet Locale uses DataSetWriterId 3 and WriterGroupName "Locale".

vectors.title: B1.2.1: Call NewDataSetWriterId
vectors.notes: PublisherId is the Responder (topic), RequestorId and MessageId are those of the IT connector; ResponseAddress is the Reply topic of the Call topic. Without CorrelationData.

vectors.title: B1.2.1: Reply NewDataSetWriterId
vectors.notes: Final response (ActionState 2) to V-PAY-008 with Status {} (Good, CompactEncoding) and the new DataSetWriterId 57211, valid for 10 s.

vectors.title: B2.2: predefined MetaData of Health
vectors.notes: Bare DataSetMetaDataType (no message): the predefined MetaData of the resource is not published via Metadata (MG 9.1.5, B2, SF-054). Health uses DeviceHealthEnumeration of OPC UA Part 100 (EnumDataTypes, namespace in Namespaces); HealthScore carries the properties EURange and EngineeringUnits (ExtensionObjects); Details is an array of the abstract DataType Structure (SF-055).

vectors.title: B2.3: predefined MetaData of Config
vectors.notes: Bare DataSetMetaDataType (no message): the predefined MetaData of the resource is not published via Metadata (MG 9.1.5, B2, SF-054). The fields are the groups of the publisher (here the group network of MG B1.1.3) and Context, both of the abstract DataType Structure (SF-055).

vectors.title: B2.7: predefined MetaData of SubscriptionList
vectors.notes: Bare DataSetMetaDataType (no message): the predefined MetaData of the resource is not published via Metadata (MG 9.1.5, B2, SF-054). Config (abstract Enumeration) has no NodeId (SF-055).

vectors.title: B2.8: predefined MetaData of ReferenceDesignation
vectors.notes: Bare DataSetMetaDataType (no message): the predefined MetaData of the resource is not published via Metadata (MG 9.1.5, B2, SF-054). Function, Product and Location (abstract Structure) have no NodeId (SF-055).

vectors.title: B1.1.5: Get Metadata of an explicit data tag
vectors.notes: A Get carries an empty MetaData (MG 9.1.5); DataSetWriterId, WriterGroupName and DataSetWriterName address the Data tag oee of B1.1.4.

vectors.title: B1.1.5: Pub Metadata of an explicit data tag, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: Complete ua-metadata of the publisher-defined DataSet oee with its publisher-defined DataSetClassId of B1.1.4 (REQ-MSG-012, SF-074); same DataSetWriterId (93), WriterGroupName and DataSetWriterName as the DataSetMessage of B1.1.4 (REQ-MSG-033). Double fields with EURange and EngineeringUnits.

vectors.title: B1.1.5: Set Metadata of an explicit data tag
vectors.notes: The requester sends the complete MetaData (incl. the publisher-defined DataSetClassId, SF-074) with a changed Description; the PublisherId is the requester's (MG 7.3).

vectors.title: B1.1.1: Birth message of an application
vectors.notes: The Birth message is the Pub MAM of the application about itself (MG 6.3.3): the Source of the topic is the AppId of the publisher, the DataSetWriterId 55 is the one of its regular Pub MAM (B1.1.1), ReplyTo is empty and the optional Timestamp/SequenceNumber are omitted like in B1.1.1 (allowed since C-026, SF-061 (a)). Published as the first message after the connect at 2021-12-16T22:25:00.000Z; the MessageId carries the time of the publication (MG 8.2.1, SF-058). The field role (C-035, Q-020 (a)) declares it as the Birth message; lint then also applies the role rules.

vectors.title: B1.1.2: Close message of an application
vectors.notes: The Close message is a Pub Health of the application about itself with NORMAL_0 and HealthScore 0 (MG 6.3.4), DataSetWriterId 3456 of its regular Pub Health (B1.1.2), published before the graceful disconnect at 2021-12-16T22:26:10.000Z. Timestamp/SequenceNumber are omitted as in the example; they may be used like in any Health message (SF-058 (b)). The field role (C-035, Q-020 (a)) declares it as the Close message; lint then also applies the role rules.

vectors.title: B1.1.2: Will message of an application
vectors.notes: The Will message is registered in the MQTT CONNECT (Will Retain false) and published by the broker after an ungraceful disconnect (MG 6.3.5): a Pub Health of the application about itself with FAILURE_1 and HealthScore 0, DataSetWriterId 3456 of its regular Pub Health (B1.1.2), without Timestamp/SequenceNumber. Its MessageId carries the time of its creation at connect, 2021-12-16T22:24:59.990Z, just before the Birth message of V-PAY-023 (MG 6.3.5, SF-058). The field role (C-035, Q-020 (a)) declares it as the Will message; lint then also applies the role rules.

vectors.title: B1.1.1: Get MAM of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: A Get MAM carries no MAM object (REQ-RES-MAM-020); the Source addresses the application itself, so the answer is its MAM on Pub/MAM/<Source> (V-PAY-028).

vectors.title: B1.1.1: Get MAM of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Without Source the Get addresses the MAM of the application and all its subordinate assets; the answer is published on Pub/MAM (V-PAY-029).

vectors.title: B1.1.1: Pub MAM of an explicit asset, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-026 (ReplyTo = its MessageId). All mandatory MAM fields are present, ManufacturerUri is a domain without scheme, DeviceManual a URL and ProductInstanceUri equals the DataSetWriterName. SoftwareRevision "1.0.1" has three numbers instead of the recommended four (REQ-RES-MAM-009, SHOULD, not checked).

vectors.title: B1.1.1: Pub MAM of all assets, self-initialized
vectors.notes: Topic without Source: one DataSetMessage per asset; here only the application itself. Self-initialized, so ReplyTo is empty.

vectors.title: B1.1.7: Get Profile of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: A Get Profile carries no Profile object (REQ-RES-PROFILE-003); the answer is V-PAY-032.

vectors.title: B1.1.7: Get Profiles of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Without Source the Get addresses the Profiles of the application and all its subordinate assets; the answer is published on Pub/Profile (V-PAY-033).

vectors.title: B1.1.7: Pub Profile of an explicit asset, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-030. Resources lists distinct names of the resources and the common service NewDataSetWriterId the application of the B1 examples serves (B1.1.1 … B1.1.10, MG 9.2.1), including MAM, Health and Profile (example corrected by SF-066 (b), GL-ADR-019).

vectors.title: B1.1.7: Pub Profiles of all assets, self-initialized
vectors.notes: Topic without Source: one DataSetMessage per asset; here only the application itself. Self-initialized, so ReplyTo is empty. Same Resources as V-PAY-032.

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Get an explicit PublicationList entry
vectors.notes: The Filter of the topic is <ResourceType>/<Tag> of the entry (Data/oee, REQ-TOP-022); the Get carries no PublicationList object. The answer is V-PAY-037.

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Get all PublicationList entries of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: With Source and without Filter the Get addresses all entries of that asset; the answer is V-PAY-038.

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Get full PublicationList of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Without Source the Get addresses all entries of the application; the answer is V-PAY-039.

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Pub an explicit PublicationList entry, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-034. WriterGroupName Data/oee is <ResourceType>/<Tag> of the entry (GL-ADR-018), DataSetWriterName its Source; the entry describes the Data publication with DataSetWriterId 93 (B1.1.4). All entries use the DataSetWriterId 161 of the PublicationList, as the note of MG 9.1.8 demands, although MG 8.2.3 requires an own id per DataSetMessage (SF-067 (a)).

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Pub all PublicationList entries of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: Entries for MAM (55), Health (3456), Profile (74), Event Syslog/Notice (625, FILTER_4), Data/oee (93) and ReferenceDesignation (94) of the application itself; MAM, Health, Profile and ReferenceDesignation have no Filter. All entries use the common DataSetWriterId 161 of the PublicationList (exception of MG 8.2.3, REQ-MSG-021).

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Pub full PublicationList of all assets, self-initialized
vectors.notes: Topic without Source: all entries of the application; here only those of the application itself, as in V-PAY-038. Self-initialized, so ReplyTo is empty. All entries use the common DataSetWriterId 161 of the PublicationList (exception of MG 8.2.3, REQ-MSG-021).

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Set an explicit PublicationList entry
vectors.notes: The IT connector sets the Interval of the Data/oee entry to 1000 ms; Config MODE_AND_INTERVAL_3 allows it. The Set carries exactly one entry and addresses it with Source and Filter. The Status event that follows belongs to RES-EVENT (C-028).

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Get ReferenceDesignation of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: A Get ReferenceDesignation carries no ReferenceDesignation object (REQ-RES-REFDES-003); the answer is V-PAY-043.

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Get ReferenceDesignation of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Without Source the Get addresses the ReferenceDesignation of all assets of the application; the answer is V-PAY-044.

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Pub ReferenceDesignation of an explicit asset, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-041 with Function, Product and Location, each with a Parent. WriterGroupName is empty because ReferenceDesignation has no Filter.

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Pub ReferenceDesignation of all assets, self-initialized
vectors.notes: Topic without Source: one DataSetMessage per asset; here only the application itself. Self-initialized, so ReplyTo is empty.

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Set ReferenceDesignation of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: The IT connector sets the complete ReferenceDesignation of the application (exactly one DataSetMessage, topic with Source). The Status event that follows belongs to RES-EVENT (C-028).

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Del ReferenceDesignation of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: The IT connector deletes the ReferenceDesignation of the application: no ReferenceDesignation object, topic with Source; sent by the requesting IT connector with empty ReplyTo (example corrected by SF-068 (a), GL-ADR-019). The Status event that follows belongs to RES-EVENT (C-028).

vectors.title: B1.1.12: Pub MAM of all assets in the requested Locale, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-007 (Get MAM with Locale de-DE): the application has a German localization, the subordinate device only English, so its LocalizedText stay en-US (fallback, REQ-LOC-002). The device has no manual and no DeviceClass: DeviceManual "" (REQ-RES-MAM-012).

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Get ReferenceDesignation of the children of an asset
vectors.notes: Get without Source with the generic helper Query (DataSetWriterId 9, WriterGroupName "Query", DataSetWriterName = requester; GL-ADR-020 amended by SF-073) and the query parameters of ReferenceDesignation: Parent is the unencoded Identification Link of the line controller, Aspect Function. The answer is V-PAY-054.

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Pub ReferenceDesignation of the children of an asset, reply to a Get
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-053: the two objects whose Function.Parent.IdentificationLink equals the requested Parent (the application itself and the subordinate asset groe.mca/DeviceModelB/AC33.447/20443), each in its own DataSetMessage, ReplyTo = MessageId of the Get. The second object has only the aspect Function. Whether the selection matches the request is a behaviour test (d7-test), not a payload check.

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Get explicit data tag of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: A Get Data carries no Data DataSetMessage (REQ-RES-DATA-006). Data has no predefined DataSetClassId; the requester does not know the publisher-defined one and omits it (REQ-MSG-011, SF-048/SF-072). The answer is V-PAY-058.

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Get all Data tags of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: Without Tag the Get addresses all Data DataSets of the asset (REQ-RES- DATA-007); no DataSetClassId (see the note of the example).

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Get Data tags of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Without Source the Get addresses all Data DataSets of all assets of the application (REQ-RES-DATA-007).

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Pub explicit Data tag of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-055 (ReplyTo = MessageId of the Get). All DataSetMessages belong to the class oee, so the NetworkMessage carries the publisher-defined DataSetClassId (REQ-MSG-011, SF-072). The content of an application-defined Data DataSet is not checked (REQ-RES-DATA-001 refers to its Metadata).

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Pub all Data tags of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: Self-initiated publication (empty ReplyTo) of all Data DataSets of the asset; more DataSetMessages or a Pagination DataSet would follow in the same NetworkMessage (REQ-RES-DATA-008, REQ-PAG-005).

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Pub Data tags of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Publication of the Data DataSets of all assets of the application (REQ-RES- DATA-008).

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Set explicit Data tag of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: The Set carries exactly one Data DataSetMessage – the complete DataSet oee – with the DataSetWriterId, DataSetWriterName and WriterGroupName of the addressed DataSet (REQ-BUS-010); the requester omits the publisher-defined DataSetClassId (REQ-MSG-011) and carries no SequenceNumber (REQ-BUS-010; removed from the example by SF-079). The answers are the Status event V-PAY-062 and a Pub Data with the ReplyTo of the Set (REQ-RES-DATA-012).

vectors.title: B1.1.4: Status Event follows a set request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Set Data V-PAY-061: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)).

vectors.title: B1.1.6: Pub Event of EventCategory Status (OPC UA Statuscode)
vectors.notes: Event of the category Status: Number is the StatusCode 0 (Good), Description describes it, Details carry SymbolicId (SF-075 (a)); Category CAT_STATUS_1 corresponds to the EventCategory Status of the topic (REQ-RES-EVENT-002, SF-076 (c)) and EventLevel Good to the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)). The ReplyTo shows that it answers a request (REQ-RES-EVENT-005). The DataSetMessage MessageType ua-event is optional and omitted.

vectors.title: B1.1.6: Pub Event of EventCategory Syslog
vectors.notes: Event of the category Syslog: Number is the PRI 13 (Facility 1 user-level × 8 + Severity 5), so the EventLevel is Notice (PRI % 8 = 5, RFC 5424 6.2.1; REQ-RES-EVENT-008, SF-076 (a)); MSG and HEADER are keys of Details and there is no Description (REQ-RES-EVENT-007, SF-075 (a)/(b)). Self-initiated (empty ReplyTo).

vectors.title: B1.1.6: Pub Event of EventCategory Generic
vectors.notes: Event of the category Generic: application-defined Number 4711, Description and Details (REQ-RES-EVENT-009); the EventLevel High is application-defined. Each EventCategory/EventLevel has its own DataSetWriterId (623, 625, 626; REQ-MSG-021).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Get explicit SubscriptionList entry
vectors.notes: A Get SubscriptionList carries no entry (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-007) and the predefined DataSetClassId (REQ-MSG-011). The answer is V-PAY-069.

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Get all SubscriptionList entries of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: Without Filter the Get addresses all entries of the asset (REQ-RES- SUBLIST-008).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Get full SubscriptionList of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Without Source the Get addresses the whole SubscriptionList of the application (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-008).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Pub an explicit SubscriptionList entry
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-066 (ReplyTo = MessageId of the Get). The entry has the common DataSetWriterId 227 of the list, the Source as DataSetWriterName and <ResourceType>/<Tag> = Data/oee as WriterGroupName, derived from the TopicPath (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-002, SF-080 (a)).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Pub all SubscriptionList entries of an explicit asset
vectors.notes: Self-initiated publication of all entries of the asset (REQ-RES- SUBLIST-009).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Pub full SubscriptionList of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Publication of the whole SubscriptionList of the application (REQ-RES- SUBLIST-009).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Set an explicit SubscriptionList entry
vectors.notes: The Set carries exactly one entry (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-010) and sets its Interval to 1000 ms; Config CONF_1 allows it (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-004). The answers are the Status event V-PAY-073 and the publication of the changed entry (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-014).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Status event follows a set request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Set SubscriptionList V-PAY-072: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Del an explicit SubscriptionList entry
vectors.notes: Unlike ReferenceDesignation, the Del carries exactly one entry whose TopicPath identifies the subscription to delete (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-011, SF-080 (a)). The answers are the Status event V-PAY-075 and the publication of the remaining entries, or nothing if none remains (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-015, SF-080 (d)). Like all B1 examples it is a standalone illustration (MessageId as in the Set example).

vectors.title: B1.1.9: Status event follows a delete request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Del SubscriptionList V-PAY-074: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)). Its text equals the Status event after the Set (V-PAY-073); each B1 example is a standalone illustration.

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Status event follows a set request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Set Config of B1.1.3: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)). B1.1.3 shows this Status event twice (after the Set of Network settings and of Overall device settings) with identical text; one vector covers both. The Config examples themselves are V-PAY-088 … 102 (C-029; the Sets V-PAY-094 … 097 and 100 … 102 refer to this vector, REQ-RES-CONFIG-021).

vectors.title: B1.1.5: Status event follows a set request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Set Metadata V-PAY-022: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)).

vectors.title: B1.1.8: Status Event follows a set request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Set PublicationList V-PAY-040: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)).

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Status Event follows a set request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Set ReferenceDesignation V-PAY-045: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)).

vectors.title: B1.1.10: Status Event follows a delete request
vectors.notes: Status event about the Del ReferenceDesignation V-PAY-046: published by the addressed application to Pub/Event/<Source>/Status/Good with the Source of the request, ReplyTo = MessageId of the request, Number 0 (Good) with SymbolicId Good in Details (SF-075 (a)); EventLevel Good is the severity class of the StatusCode (REQ-RES-EVENT-004, SF-076 (b)). After the deletion of the whole object nothing else is published (REQ-BUS-007).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Get explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (network)
vectors.notes: Requests the Config DataSet "Network settings" of the asset: the Filter is the topic Filter, the Get carries no Config DataSetMessage (REQ-RES-CONFIG-016) and the predefined DataSetClassId of Config (REQ-MSG-011). The Filter is read as the stable name of the DataSet, not as the localized Context.Name (REQ-RES-CONFIG-015, SF-085; defined in MG 8.3.3.1/8.3.3.2 since a77d331). Answered by V-PAY-091 (REQ-RES-CONFIG-017).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Get all Config tags of an explicit asset with Locale
vectors.notes: Requests all Config DataSets of the asset in de-DE: the only DataSetMessage is the helper DataSet Locale (DataSetWriterId 3, REQ-MSG-019), no Config DataSetMessage (REQ-RES-CONFIG-016). The Pub V-PAY-092 has ReplyTo "" and en-US texts, so it is read as an unsolicited publication, not as the answer to this Get (SF-088 (f)).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Get Config tags of all assets related to this application
vectors.notes: Requests the Config DataSets of all assets of the application (topic without Source and Filter); no Config DataSetMessage (REQ-RES-CONFIG-016). The Pub V-PAY-093 has ReplyTo "" and is read as an unsolicited publication (SF-088 (f)).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Pub explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (network)
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-088 (ReplyTo = MessageId of the Get). One Config DataSetMessage with group network (ip_address, subnet-mask, port) and the Context "Network settings"; every configuration object carries Type, Value and Name (REQ-RES-CONFIG-002), values are strings (REQ-RES-CONFIG-007) and satisfy their Validation (REQ-RES-CONFIG-008). Synced with the guideline after SF-088 (e) (description of ip_address "IP address of the network interface").

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Pub all Config tags of an explicit asset (network)
vectors.notes: Same DataSet as V-PAY-091 with ReplyTo "": an unsolicited publication (SF-088 (f)). Synced with the guideline after SF-088 (e) ("network configuration", description of ip_address).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Pub Config tags of all assets related to this application (network)
vectors.notes: Same DataSet as V-PAY-091 with ReplyTo "" on the topic without Source and Filter: an unsolicited publication, self-initialized by the application (SF-088 (f)). Synced with the guideline after SF-088 (e) (description of ip_address).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Set explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (network, new values, minimal)
vectors.notes: Partial Set of the network example ("Network settings", DataSetWriterId 42): only the Values of the group network (REQ-RES-CONFIG-003, SF-086 (a)), exactly one DataSetMessage with the DataSetWriterId, DataSetWriterName and WriterGroupName of the addressed DataSet (REQ-RES-CONFIG-019, REQ-BUS-010). The answers are the Status event (REQ-RES-CONFIG-021, MG B1.1.3 Status event = V-PAY-076) and a Pub Config with the changed values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-022); B1.1.3 shows only the Status event for the network example.

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Set explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (network, new values, full)
vectors.notes: Set of the network example ("Network settings", DataSetWriterId 42) repeating the read-only properties of the Pub unchanged together with the new Values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-003; changed read-only properties would be rejected, REQ-RES-CONFIG-023, SF-086 (c)). The answers are the Status event (REQ-RES-CONFIG-021, MG B1.1.3 Status event = V-PAY-076) and a Pub Config with the changed values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-022); B1.1.3 shows only the Status event for the network example. Synced with the guideline after SF-088 (e) (description of ip_address).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Set explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (network, empty values, minimal)
vectors.notes: Unsets all configuration objects of the group network with an empty Value (REQ-RES-CONFIG-010); none of them is mandatory. The answers are the Status event (REQ-RES-CONFIG-021, MG B1.1.3 Status event = V-PAY-076) and a Pub Config with the changed values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-022); B1.1.3 shows only the Status event for the network example.

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Set explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (network, empty values, full)
vectors.notes: Like V-PAY-096, repeating the read-only properties unchanged (REQ-RES-CONFIG-003, SF-086 (c)). The answers are the Status event (REQ-RES-CONFIG-021, MG B1.1.3 Status event = V-PAY-076) and a Pub Config with the changed values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-022); B1.1.3 shows only the Status event for the network example. Synced with the guideline after SF-088 (e) (description of ip_address).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Get explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (device)
vectors.notes: Requests the Config DataSet "Overall device settings" of the device example (DataSetWriterId 43 since SF-088 (d)); no Config DataSetMessage (REQ-RES-CONFIG-016). Answered by V-PAY-099.

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Pub explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (device)
vectors.notes: Answer to V-PAY-098 (ReplyTo = MessageId of the Get). Two groups device1 and common (REQ-RES-CONFIG-013/014) with mandatory (aut0-r3fr3sh, protocol) and sensitive (password) configuration objects; the unset password is published as empty string (REQ-RES-CONFIG-024, GL-ADR-021). Verbatim since the guideline corrections of SF-088 (a) … (d) (common, unit, escaped Pattern dots, no "Unit": "Temperature", DataSetWriterId 43); the former edits are dropped.

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Set explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (device, new values, minimal)
vectors.notes: Partial Set of the device example ("Overall device settings", DataSetWriterId 43 since SF-088 (d)): Values of both groups including the mandatory objects aut0-r3fr3sh and protocol of device1 (REQ-RES-CONFIG-011), exactly one DataSetMessage (REQ-RES-CONFIG-019, REQ-BUS-010); the new sensitive password is sent in clear text (REQ-RES-CONFIG-026, GL-ADR-021). The answers are the Status event (REQ-RES-CONFIG-021, MG B1.1.3 Status event = V-PAY-076) and the Pub Config with the changed, masked values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-022/024, V-PAY-114).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Set explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (device, new values, full)
vectors.notes: Set of the device example ("Overall device settings", DataSetWriterId 43 since SF-088 (d)) repeating the read-only properties of V-PAY-099 together with the new Values; the new sensitive password is sent in clear text (REQ-RES-CONFIG-026, GL-ADR-021). Verbatim since the guideline corrections of SF-088 (a) … (d); the former edits are dropped. The answers are the Status event (REQ-RES-CONFIG-021, MG B1.1.3 Status event = V-PAY-076) and the Pub Config with the changed, masked values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-022/024, V-PAY-114).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Set explicit Config tag of an explicit asset (device, empty values, minimal)
vectors.notes: Unsets the configuration objects of the device example ("Overall device settings", DataSetWriterId 43 since SF-088 (d)) with an empty Value (REQ-RES-CONFIG-010), including the mandatory aut0-r3fr3sh and protocol: format-valid, the owner may reject it with Bad (REQ-RES-CONFIG-011, SF-086 (b)). user-name is unset to "" as well since SF-088 (e).

vectors.title: B1.1.3: Pub explicit Config tag after a successful set request (device)
vectors.notes: Answer to the Sets V-PAY-100/101 (ReplyTo = MessageId of the Set) after the Status event (V-PAY-076): the complete Config DataSet "Overall device settings" with the values of the Set (REQ-RES-CONFIG-022); the non-empty sensitive password is published as the mask "********" (REQ-RES-CONFIG-024, GL-ADR-021, SF-087). Example added to MG B1.1.3 with GL-ADR-021 (912e35b).

vectors.title: MG 1.2: Pub Health reply (capitalization example)
vectors.notes: The PascalCase example of MG 1.2 is a Pub Health of the field data service about itself in reply to a Get (ReplyTo is the MessageId of V-PAY-001), like V-PAY-003 but without SequenceNumber. DataSetWriterId was 3875 until SF-095 (b) aligned it with V-PAY-003 (guideline e25f64f). The guideline names no topic; it is completed from the PublisherId and the DataSetWriterName.

edits.reason: MG 1.2 shows the message without its topic; Pub Health of the publisher about itself (DataSetWriterName = AppId).

vectors.title: MG 8.1.1: ua-data with SequenceNumber, MetaDataVersion, Status and MessageType (Figure 5)
vectors.notes: Self-initialized Pub Health (ReplyTo "") of an application whose Identification Link is a URL (https scheme). The DataSetMessage carries every optional field of the fixed content mask: SequenceNumber, MetaDataVersion 1.0, a Timestamp with UTC offset, the non-Good Status UncertainLastUsableValue (Code and Symbol) and MessageType ua-keyframe. The MessageId time (2019-06-26T11:36:00Z) differs from the Timestamp; MessageIds are opaque (REQ-MSG-009). The guideline names no topic; it is completed from the PublisherId and the DataSetWriterName.

edits.reason: MG 8.1.1 shows the message without its topic; Pub Health of the publisher about itself (DataSetWriterName = AppId).

vectors.title: MG 8.1.3: Call NewDataSetWriterId with CorrelationData (Figure 7)
vectors.notes: V-PAY-008 (B1.2.1) with CorrelationData "MTYzOTY5MzUxMDAwMA==" (base64 of the request time 1639693510000), which the Responder returns unchanged in V-PAY-120 (REQ-ACT-007).

vectors.title: MG 8.1.3: Reply NewDataSetWriterId with CorrelationData (Figure 8)
vectors.notes: Final response (ActionState 2) to V-PAY-119 on its ResponseAddress, with the CorrelationData of the request unchanged; otherwise V-PAY-009 (B1.2.1).

vectors.title: MG 8.1.2: ua-metadata of a user-defined DataSet (Figure 6)
vectors.notes: Self-initialized Pub Metadata (ReplyTo "") of the publisher-defined Data DataSet "Temperature" of a temperature sensor (Source) behind the field data service, DataSetWriterId 15, Filter = WriterGroupName "Temperature". Without DataSetClassId (publisher-defined DataSet, REQ-MSG-012 "may"). The field Temperature (Double, i=11) has the property EngineeringUnits (EUInformation, degree Celsius, UNECE CEL = UnitId 4408652) – the KeyValuePair example of MG 8.2.8. The guideline names no topic; it is completed from the PublisherId, DataSetWriterName and WriterGroupName.
